content: {"reasoning":"CO-97 indicates the service is contractually bundled into another paid service, and the case shows no coding or claim-data error that would support correction and resubmission. Appeals, peer-to-peer review, records submissions, and repeat clean claims produced no payments on similar claims, while billing the patient or secondary for a contractual bundling denial would be improper. With no collectible balance remaining, the appropriate closure is a write-off.","action":"write_off"}
